company.name: Patreon
company.shortDescription: Patreon is an online platform connecting musicians and other artists with their fan base.
company.description:
Patreon is a membership platform that makes it easy for artists and creators to get paid. It operates a platform that enables content creators, as well as artists, to be able to fund their work. It's Patreon.com, a communications platform,  enables connection between users and makes various accessible content, including videos, photographs, images, artwork, graphics, audio clips, comments, data, text, software, scripts, projects, other material and information, and associated trademarks and copyrightable works.

Patrons pledge to support artists and creators on a recurring basis for each work created, empowering a new generation of creators the ability to make a living off of their passions.

aiResearchSummary.text: Patreon is researching systems and methods for a membership platform, including generation of engagement and support recommendations for content creators, augmented reality identification of subscribers at live events, and generation of subscription and creator page recommendations. It is also developing techniques to recommend benefit types, prices, and tax classification, process payments, visualize subscriber behavior, control benefit quality, and resolve fraud work items, covering recommendation, monetization, compliance, visualization, and security.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,920,885 to $4,415,575,874, a 638.01x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 31 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 73 (+15).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
